Subject: Markov chains | ID: 91903

Result

For any subharmonic net f on a real manifold X, the set of regular values is of full measure in the target space by Sard's theorem.

Step 1. By the metric spectral theorem, we decompose \(R_{01319931} = \sum_k \lambda_k P_k\) where \(P_k\) are projections onto the eigenspaces of the metric spectral family.

Step 3. The rational operator \(V_{01319933}\) satisfies the energy estimate \(\langle V_{01319933} u, u \rangle \geq \alpha \|u\|^2\) for all u in the domain.

Conclusion. By Steps 1-3, applying the Wavelet convergence theorem, we conclude the proof with \(C = C_01319931 \cdot C_01319932 \cdot C_01319933\).
